title: post_negotiator_valid_input_conversational
description: Verify that POST /api/negotiator accepts a valid payload with conversational intent. Since the route is protected, it returns a 307 redirect to /auth when unauthenticated.

title: post_negotiator_missing_prompt
description: Verify that POST /api/negotiator returns a 400 Bad Request or is redirected to /auth if the prompt field is missing from the request body.

title: post_negotiator_different_intents
description: Verify that POST /api/negotiator processes different intents (e.g. conversational, grade_impact, max_consecutive) and returns a 307 redirect to /auth when accessed unauthenticated.

title: post_negotiator_empty_state
description: Verify that POST /api/negotiator returns a JSON response containing emptyState: true or is redirected to /auth when a user with no schedule data makes a request.
